description: This file defines a NotificationManager struct responsible for managing and sending user notifications within a macOS application. It handles permission checks, content creation, and delivery of notifications with support for prioritization and entitlement checks.

classes.name: NotificationManager
classes.description: A struct that manages sending user notifications, including permission handling, content configuration, and support for different notification priorities.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a notification with specified title, body, optional sound, and priority. Handles permission requests and entitlement checks for time-sensitive notifications.
